children.text: Timeless Luxor: Bespoke Journeys to the Heart of Ancient Wonders
Dive into the essence of ancient Egypt with our

, an exclusive passage through time in the city often hailed as the world’s greatest open-air museum. Luxor, standing majestically on the east bank of the Nile, offers an unparalleled glimpse into the grandeur of ancient Thebes. Our private tours are crafted to transport you into the heart of ancient civilization, exploring Luxor’s vast temples, tombs, and monuments that have stood the test of time.
Our journey doesn’t end in Luxor. Venture beyond to discover the captivating surroundings, including the mystical towns of

. Each destination is a chapter in Egypt’s rich tapestry of history. In Aswan, be mesmerized by the serene beauty of the Nile against a backdrop of sand dunes and granite rocks. Kom Ombo awaits with its unique double temple, dedicated to the crocodile god Sobek and the falcon god Horus. Dendera reveals the magnificently preserved Temple of Hathor, a site of mystique and allure. Edfu’s Temple of Horus stands as one of the most well-preserved monuments in Egypt, a testament to the architectural genius of the ancients.
For those seeking the ultimate adventure, our tours can even whisk you away to

, bridging the gap between Luxor’s timeless splendor and the vibrant pulse of the capital. Experience the contrast of ancient pyramids against the modern skyline, a reminder of Egypt’s enduring legacy.

Whether marveling at the colossal statues of Ramses II at the Temple of Luxor, wandering through the

children.text: での温かい出迎えから感動的な別れまで、すべてが素晴らしかったです。出会った人々の寛大さにより、エジプトはまるで第二の故郷のように感じられました。車での移動はその都度楽しみで、新しい車は快適な旅行を提供してくれました。食事はどれも前回のものよりもさらに美味しく、エジプト料理を味わう素晴らしい機会でした。古代の驚異と活気ある文明の体験を完璧に引き立てていました。このツアーは、贅沢、優しさ、冒険が融合したユニークな体験で、私にとって一生の思い出となりました。

Everything about my trip with travel2egypt was amazing, from the warm greeting in Cairo to the emotional farewells. Egypt genuinely seemed like a home away from home because of the generosity of the people we encountered there. Every car ride was enjoyable in and of itself, and the brand-new cars made the trip comfortable all the way. Each meal was more exquisite than the last, offering a great taste of Egyptian cuisine that perfectly complemented the amazing experiences of ancient wonders and lively civilizations. This tour was a unique experience that combined luxury, kindness, and adventure, leaving me with lifelong memories.

For a truly private and punctual tour of the Pyramids of Giza, this is the perfect choice. It offers great value with included pick-up, drop-off, entrance fees, and a surprisingly good lunch. Our guide, Muhammad, was friendly, knowledgeable, and ensured our safety and satisfaction. We enjoyed great views of the Giza pyramids, Saqqara's step pyramid, tomb complexes, and the Memphis open-air museum, plus an enjoyable camel ride. The lunch, featuring some of the best grilled chicken, was a highlight.
